name: freshworks-developer-tooling
description: Freshworks Platform 3.0 app development, AI Actions, publishing, and FDK management skills. For MCP: add the freshworks-marketplace server to ~/.cursor/mcp.json or .cursor/mcp.json with your API key from the Developer Portal profile.

interface.shortDescription: FDK setup, Platform 3.0 apps, AI Actions, and marketplace publish.
interface.longDescription: Cursor plugin root for Freshworks skills: fw-setup (FDK/nvm), fw-app-dev (Platform 3.0 apps), fw-ai-app-dev (AI Actions), fw-publish (MCP). Copy **`.mcp.json`** from this repository into project **`.cursor/mcp.json`** and add your Developer Portal JWT.
